steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It's your turn to move.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If you can kill me here, all of my forces will collapse.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It would be such a pity if you refused to even have a chat with me. Please, come kill me - if you can, that is.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: The enemy's attacks are too overwhelming! We can't afford to drag this out any longer!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The situation is quite straightforward - only one of us will survive.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I promise to keep my last words short, Madam, as long as you can make me say them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you think yourself a martyr?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nobody will remember you after you die. Being dead and being respected are two completely different matters. What matters is what you've done in life, not how you die.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I obviously wish for nothing more than to play with worthwhile foes, and then to die a worthwhile death.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But I don't think you'll be able to help me fulfill my desires after all. You will suffer a terrible defeat, Madam. Now it's my turn to point out the situation that you're in.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your confidence was built upon the fall of Chernobog.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But this isn't Chernobog, nor is this the ruthless land of Ursus.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The mighty Lungmen will not fall into the hands of scum like you.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Well said.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: GROOAAAAAR!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Was that a slash? N-no, impossible! Could this be... Arts?!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Back off.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What... How can this be?

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: (Groans in anguish)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Don't be afraid!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It won't hurt you. There's no need to be afraid.

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: UNNGGHHH...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (He's too far. It's only going to get harder for me to close the gap. I'm at a disadvantage if this drags out.)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Your skills are formidable.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You used your Arts to detonate Faust's attack in advance, and broke through my formation. Your blade even cut through my guard's neck and almost reached me.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If I had let you come a few steps closer, you would have cut me in half. Not even Faust would've been able to stop you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You won't be so lucky next time.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Unfortunately, there won't be a next time. Your secret has been exposed, Madam.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You've heard the saying - never try the same trick twice. You can't fool your audience again after the secret comes out.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The distance between us is greater than your Arts' range, isn't it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The rooftop is only so big. You don't have much room to move back.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: How much closer can you get?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust, show her what real Arts are.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know your position all too well. An exposed sniper poses no...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You are remarkable, Madam Ch'en. Are you able to cut through any shot fired at you? Just like before, I could barely even see your movements.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sniper, I was attacked by you and someone from 3 o'clock simultaneously. But there's nobody in that direction.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I doubt you're that kind of caster.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: There's no need for you to try to guess, Officer. You won't figure it out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Now, how many shots will you be able to deflect? Ten? Forty? A hundred?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But, how about the shrapnel? The blast? What about the Arts inside?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Are you able to stop all of it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nonsense.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Then, let's keep going!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Officer, I know what you are. My Originium Arts only work on the Infected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't care.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Don't you know that you're only going to become his pawn, to be discarded when you've served your purpose?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You can have those words back.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: We will give you a chance. Lungmen will not.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, I'm afraid we'll have to make our way down! We can't deal with the enemy's fierce attacks!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Tsk... As soon as I want to move, the sniper will attack me from all directions. Just how is he doing that...?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (I can neutralize his ranged attacks, but if I let him keep wearing me down, I won't last long.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (I'll have to seize victory in a single decisive moment...!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't care what you have to say. I don't have time to listen to your blathering.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (I can see a red aura congealing around her. She's about to use her Arts.)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (Mephisto, according to the plan, if I shoot her now, she'll have to stop her casting or she'll die in the explosion.)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But wouldn't this be the best opportunity to break her spirit? Hold your fire, and just watch her first.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: We will miss our opportunity.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Broader strategic goals are more important than the specific tactics used to get there, Faust.
Come with me! Don't stay here anymore!
Do you not want to leave here? Let's get far, far away from these people, and this place!
Do you really not know? He's the reason why all the adults treat us like this! It's all his fault!
I hate this accursed city. I hate him. Don't make me hate you too.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chi Xiao—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: —Unsheathe!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Guards, form a line! Stop her!

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: EEEEAAAAAARRRGHH!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ugh...!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (N-no! I lost control of Chi Xiao? Why now of all times?!)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Her Arts paused. Her casting failed.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust, now.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Command, fire.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Damn it... Scatter!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What a terrifying weapon.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Just the dispersion of your Arts was powerful enough to block all the bolts, as well disable three of my guards.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But you were still hit by the blast, weren't you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ugh... Gahh...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (One rib, no, two are broken? I can endure it. But this firepower... There's no way I can take another...)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It's just like our leader said.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Madam, it's not that you don't want to kill me. You cannot unsheathe that sword.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What did you say? Who told you that?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You should know this name, Madam Ch'en. As you said, this sword was not to be meant to be used against someone like me. Your recklessness disrupted its intended mechanism.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If we seized the opportunity to attack you while you were defenseless, you would have already been turned into dust. She already knows all your weaknesses.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You waste your breath.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: We will destroy this world as it currently is.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If we allow the rampant corruption to grow, the entire world will rot away.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Only by cutting it all away can these rusted cities break free from their chains and be born anew.

steps.name: Mephisto's Herd
steps.text: GRAAAAAAGHHH!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Out of my way.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Come, Madam Ch'en. Aren't you also very disappointed in Lungmen?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Our leader is waiting for you. There's no reason why you need to bow your head to Lungmen, is there?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have my duties.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: That has nothing to do with which side you take. While you keep talking about these mundane 'duties,' you know just how our fellow peoples are being treated.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Just give me a sign, then I'll call off the attack immediately. Come, join us. Let us work towards the greater good together.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Spits*. This mouthful of blood is the only sign I have for you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What kind of noble goals could Reunion possibly have if they hire a lowlife like you? Spare me your nonsense!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: So, that's how it's going to be. If you don't believe me, then that's your loss.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You can spend your last moments squirming all you want. My guardian and his bolts will show you the true power of the Infected.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You are all alone, while we are united and strong. Your death will be fitting.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Save those rotten words until after you're dead.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Or, you could forcefully activate the Originium Arts imbued in that sword. Something terrible will happen, right? I'll let you decide your own fate.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you think you'll get a hero's death?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Listen, brat. When one dies, nothing is left behind.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If I have to sacrifice myself to kill you...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll do it, even though it's not worth it.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: We have nothing more to talk about then. Goodbye, Madam Ch'en. Faust.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Command, f—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tch...
You don't need to go that far, Madam Ch'en!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A helicopter? No, that doesn't look like one. It's...
Blaze, jump!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Mind your landing posture! Don't leave my heat flow!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: What's that? Someone's jumping down?!
'As terror rises, her eyes become blind...'

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Damn, Rhodes Island? From above?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: These black lines... Wait, is that you...
'...As the tears dry, she weeps silently.'

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: ...Nghh...

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: ...Nngh, uuughhh...

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: Ughh.... Aaaargh! Ugh!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What's going on here? Why are my guards screaming as if they're grieving?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: My Arts should have wiped all their emotions, so why? What's going on?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Is that you?!! Damn you!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The Rabbit of Rhodes Island!!
I temporarily restricted their movement, but it'll only last for about ten seconds!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's more than enough time for me to make a safe zone!
Let's do it, Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Are we ready to go all out?
Yes, now!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We're about to land - your bottom might get a little sore!
Don't drop me!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Command, fire!
Don't underestimate us!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...My bolts were diverted by the wind? How could this...
Cut the roof apart from underneath those Reunion troops!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sure thing, but make sure to hold on tight! I can only do this once every few months!

steps.name: Mephisto's Herd
steps.text: Uh... Urgh?

steps.name: Mephisto's Herd
steps.text: Aaaaaaaghh!!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: She cut a huge crack through the roof of the building!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know. Watch out for falling debris!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: What's going on here? How'd she do that? What happened?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Woah, a lot of Reunion's forces fell onto this level!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Forget them, hold on tight!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hello, hello?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You don't need to be in such a hurry to get yourself killed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We're in the middle of a crisis. What are you doing on this channel?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Oh, I just wanted to tell you that I'm done with my mission.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Rhodes Island has something really powerful, and they'll be here with it soon.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They're already here. What was this mission of yours anyway?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Coordinating with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Safe landing!
Blaze, you can put me down.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You... you guys...
Madam Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry it took us so long to get here, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In accordance to our agreement, Rhodes Island will now be supporting you.
A few minutes ago...
4:21 A.M. \ Overcast
Call Sign: 'Bad Guy', 40m above L.G.D. Headquarters, Upper Lungmen

options: All right, it's time for your debut!
Look at that sorry shape she's in. She needs your help, Amiya.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why are you so enthusiastic about this? She left you to die in that ruined city, so isn't it only right to let her wallow in her helplessness?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze, don't be like that. Dr. {@nickname} is right. We have to resolve Lungmen's problem first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Otherwise, everything we've done will have been for naught.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Fine, if that's an order, I'll do it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But to be honest, I don't really want to help that woman.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze, we can't let all our efforts over the last three months go to waste.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hitting me with the cost versus benefit, huh? Whatever, I just have to do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Some things can wait until after Lungmen is safe.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: When that time comes, we're gonna make a fortune!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I mean, we look like we've been beaten up even worse than her, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What a pain. I didn't expect that woman in the ruined city to be so arrogant. Kal'tsit never even gave me a heads up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll treat you to curry after we get back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can take some time to rest up afterwards. But right now, we need to put an end to this battle once and for all.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: All right, we have a deal. Let's go!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Why are you bunch here?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to be here, Mephisto.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What the hell is FrostNova doing? What's going on with her anyway? Did she pass out again?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You accursed rabbit... You and your entire rabble were supposed to freeze to death in Chernobog!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I cannot die yet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As long as Oripathy continues to plague these lands, our battle will never end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We will rid the world of psychopaths like you, as well as the persecution that the Infected face!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Aha... Ahaha...!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Come, little rabbit, if I am your enemy, then come kill me! Kill me! Kill me right now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No... You are not my enemy.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Then I will slaughter you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If you seek a glorious death, you will not find it here. I only wish to destroy your hatred and malice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What happens to you is of no concern to me. But look at the Infected around you. Your death will bring nothing to them.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have no empathy to spare for the likes of you, at least for the time being.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Are you trying to make an enemy out of Reunion, out of all of us? Do you want to taste how deep the wrath of the Infected runs?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not all Infected are the same. You and Miss FrostNova have nothing in common. Not everyone in Reunion is a psychopath like you.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What did she tell you? That woman...!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Aren't you misunderstanding something?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I am the one who can control these cities and bend all these pawns to my will! Not her!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's why... If someone has to bring you to justice, then I will be the one to do it!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's right. Plus, weren't we enemies long ago?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We became enemies the moment you began to spread terror and tragedy!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, please hold on a bit longer. Our support squad will be there shortly.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...There's too much noise. I didn't hear your battle plan, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah. I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Give us your orders, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yan has an old saying, 'to catch bandits, you must first catch the ringleader.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: In other words, if we want to destroy our enemies, we have to capture their commander first.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Be careful. His mindless minions will rise up again and again.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Free them from their suffering if you can.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor.

options: Underestood. I'll issue commands from the rear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze, I'll break their formation with my Arts. I'm counting on you to push back their attacks!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to take some of the pressure off from Madam Ch'en!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She's certainly strong, but do you think she's that strong? Do you think she can take down those two by herself? I highly doubt it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I trust that the Doctor's leadership will help her get the job done.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll be engaging the enemy commander next.

options: You'll need help to clear the way, right? No problem!
I'll give you an opportunity to get to the enemy commander.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Regardless of what I said before, you have my trust this time.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Rhodes Island, are you in cahoots with Lungmen now?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Now that I'm seeing this for myself, I'm starting to realize how shameful this is for us Infected.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It only took four of us to drive you into the corner. The only shameful thing here is you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mephisto, your atrocities end here!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust! Wipe them out, every single one! Get them out of my sight!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's time to end this battle.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Only then... can we prepare for the next one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your orders, Dr. {@nickname}.

options: Assist Madam Ch'en, and reclaim the L.G.D. Headquarters!
